description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts (support+NEI); one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Leukemia associated Rho guanine nucleotide-exchange factor represses RhoA in response to SRC activation.
Claim 2: Assembly of invadopodia is triggered by focal generation of phosphatidylinositol-3,4-biphosphate and the activation of the nonreceptor tyrosine kinase Src.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Leukemia associated Rho guanine nucleotide-exchange factor represses RhoA in response to SRC activation.
Assembly of invadopodia is triggered by focal generation of phosphatidylinositol-3,4-biphosphate and the activation of the nonreceptor tyrosine kinase Src.
rationale: The expression of various phosphoinositide-binding domains revealed that the podosomes in Src-transformed NIH3T3 (NIH-src) cells are enriched with PtdIns(3,4)P2, suggesting an important role of this phosphoinositide in podosome formation.
Live-cell imaging analysis revealed that Src-expression stimulated podosome formation at focal adhesions of NIH3T3 cells after PtdIns(3,4)P2 accumulation.
